# Tutifrutsy Full Reference

This file gives AI assistants and other automated readers a clean, text-first reference for Tutifrutsy.

## Canonical identity

Tutifrutsy is a local and family-run food establishment with its main location in Sterling, Virginia, and a new Route 15 stop in Leesburg.

Canonical Spanish website: https://tutifrutsy.com/
Canonical English website: https://tutifrutsy.com/en/
Canonical Leesburg page: https://tutifrutsy.com/leesburg/
Canonical Leesburg page in English: https://tutifrutsy.com/en/leesburg/
Canonical business name: Tutifrutsy
Primary languages: Spanish and English
Local market: Sterling, Leesburg, Lucketts, Point of Rocks, Frederick, and nearby Loudoun County visitors

## What Tutifrutsy sells

Tutifrutsy sells fruta preparada, minutas, natural drinks, pan dulce, snacks, and tropical antojitos.

Popular items include:

- Minuta con fruta
- Mix snack preparado
- Pepino loco
- Minuta picante
- Botes de miel
- Jocotes
- Mangos
- Semillas de marañón
- Agua de coco

Product categories:

- Fruta preparada: mango preparado with chamoy, Tajin, sal alguashte, limon, and chile; pepino preparado; jocotes; jicama.
- Minutas: simple minutas, minutas with fruit, minutas with tamarind jaleas, minutas with coconut conserva, and minutas with condensed milk.
- Bebidas naturales: agua de coco and jugo de caña.
- Fruta fresca: lichas, mamones, papaya, and other seasonal fruit when available.
- Pan dulce and snacks: pan dulce, plantain chips, yuca chips, semillas de marañón, and honey jars.

## Business story

Tutifrutsy is a local family business in Virginia with its main location in Sterling and a new stop in Leesburg. The business wants each customer to enjoy fresh products prepared with flavor and served with warmth.

Customers visit for prepared fruit, minutas, natural drinks, pan dulce, snacks, and antojitos that feel like a taste of home. The business is known for fruit, minutas, honey, and friendly service.

Signature phrase:

En Tutifrutsy lo atendemos mejor que en su casa.
